summary: The paper proposes a new transformer variant for tabular regression but understates the role of preprocessing in the reported gains. Clear writing and a careful ablation, but headline claims rest on a small benchmark suite.
strengths: Clean separation of preprocessing, architecture, and training contributions.

concerns.issue: All headline results come from three datasets in the same domain; the abstract claims general-purpose superiority.
concerns.suggested_fix: Rerun on a heterogeneous benchmark (e.g. add OpenML-CC18 subset) before claiming generality, or soften the claim in the abstract.

concerns.issue: The bias term is computed using the validation set, leaking information into the training loop.
concerns.suggested_fix: Recompute the bias term on a held-out chunk of the training set; rerun §4.1 and §4.2.

concerns.issue: Compute costs are reported only in wall-clock seconds, not FLOPs.
concerns.suggested_fix: Add a FLOPs estimate or note the GPU model used.
